criteria.description: One brand, four primary entries (three plain + one disclosure), three title-only destinations, one always-visible toggle, one chevron, ten large overlay links, newsletter form (email + secondary submit + terms privacy link), contact phone/email/address, and five social links are authored

Native disclosure activation, stable desktop hover transfer, click pin, Escape, outside/destination close, overlay toggle open/close with primary-row hide, and breakpoint coordination reach every state
The dropdown trigger, toggle, chevron, and close icon have one owner with no duplicate rendering
Desktop logo-start / primary-centered / toggle-end full-width bar; overlay under bar without horizontal overflow; large links grid and newsletter/contact column relationships preserved
JavaScript-disabled experience hides the inert toggle and exposes overlay destinations, newsletter, contact, and native disclosure usability
Visible focus, 44px targets, semantic links, reduced motion, light/dark, single primary landmark without nested nav, and WCAG 2.1 AA pass
Codex reviewed fresh desktop, tablet, mobile, dark, overlay-open, and JavaScript-disabled captures
